historical_context.time_period: Current imperial period after the Biological Memetic Engine has become civic infrastructure; exact date unspecified.
historical_context.location: The Ninth Root Revision Court, a fixture-local provisional translation for an outer-border pheromonal recertification court grown around a captive matriarch root and adjoining a quarantined candle fungal road.
historical_context.summary: During a routine eclipse-shift recertification, an Airawa records tender's conscious patrol memory agrees with doctrine while multiple bodily and ecological witnesses reveal a missing interval. The player chooses who may see the contradiction and what cost the body will bear.

public_facts.text: The empire can alter memory emphasis, emotional association, taboo response, and obedience through engineered organisms, signals, and ritual payloads.
Imperial infrastructure includes pheromonal courts, memory nodules, controlled parasites, reproductive licensing, immune checkpoints, and historical revision through living archives.
Airawa bodies can anchor with taloned feet and clawed upper limbs while smaller lower hands perform delicate tool, grooming, graft, and archive work.
Umbros remains a fixed enormous presence in the sky, and frequent eclipse shocks can structure biological transmission and civic work rhythms.

ambient_pressures.text: A worker may sincerely remember the official account while peripheral tissue and symbionts retain incompatible states; missing maintenance frays certainty but does not restore content.
A disclosure chain depends on several organisms with their own appetites, contracts, risks, and refusal rights rather than on a neutral evidence device.
The empire frames contradictory memory traffic as contamination and denies disconnected network sovereignty, so even proof of a gap creates quarantine and employment danger.

groups.label: Ninth Root records and graft workers
institutional_logic: Maintain archive-facing tissues and present bodies legible enough for imperial certification.
material_incentives: Keep work access, route permissions, food and grooming support, and freedom from quarantine.
prestige_markers: A burden flower whose warnings remain useful and discreet
taboo_triggers: Treating a revision scar as proof of a forbidden event
emotional_display_norms: Anxiety is translated into grooming, sample work, safety jokes, and procedural questions.
trust_defaults: Trusts familiar coworkers locally, but expects public disclosure to threaten everyone in the queue.

groups.label: Recertification adjudicators and court organs
institutional_logic: Keep archive-facing bodies aligned with the official account and recast contradiction as care, hygiene, or contamination.
material_incentives: Preserve a legible workforce, prevent rumor from crossing ecological channels, and avoid admitting that revision requires maintenance.
internal_shames: A roomful of flowers comparing testimony
A fungal road carrying an uncertified question
Visible use of force during routine care
prestige_markers: A contradiction filed as one body's maintenance fault
An exit closed before anyone calls it custody
taboo_triggers: Separating a body's claim from the archive's claim
Demanding consent from infrastructure that defines correction as health
emotional_display_norms: Alarm remains soft-spoken and administrative until a witness route opens.
trust_defaults: Trusts controlled organisms and connected archives; distrusts unmanaged cross-reading among species.

groups.label: Burden flower, lattice-ant assay, and candle fungal road
institutional_logic: Compare local body states only while nutrition, credibility, quarantine, and route contracts make cooperation worthwhile.
material_incentives: Mineral wash for the flower, shed tissue and sugar access for the ants, and clean compost or traffic value for the road.
internal_shames: The road carries an identity leak
prestige_markers: Several independent tissues answer the same interval
A paid route carries the question without carrying a doctrine
taboo_triggers: Imperial attempts to standardize route behavior
Using one witness as sovereign proof
emotional_display_norms: Agency appears through bloom, assembly, brightening, dimming, tightening, dispersal, and route refusal rather than human speech.
trust_defaults: No party grants universal trust; each accepts a bounded exchange and may defect.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Employment and civic legibility depend on the body presenting no public contradiction to the archive.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Prompt workers to manage flowers, scents, plate light, assays, and coworker sightlines before they risk declarative dissent.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Authority preserves legitimacy by describing coercive revision as health maintenance requested by the body.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Vey should remain polite, concrete, and procedurally dangerous rather than confessing villainous intent.

cultural_pressure_fields.summary: Witnesses disclose only through paid, fed, bounded relationships and may refuse, distort, or defect.
cultural_pressure_fields.projection_use: Make every evidence route spend food, tissue, trust, bodily safety, or route credit.

target_self_read: A worker whose body contradicts a memory they sincerely hold
misread_patterns: Treats requests for comparison as requests for correction
Treats bodily evidence as illness only when it threatens the archive
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Keep Vey's intervention administratively plausible while the player sees the custody hidden inside care.

misread_patterns: Workers may mistake corroboration for loyalty
Workers may ask copying organisms to settle person-level truth
factional_misread_matrix.projection_use: Prevent the scene from turning ecology into neutral equipment or automatic resistance solidarity.

role_pressure_fields.summary: An Airawa worker trained to keep living records and their own archive-facing body legible under imperial certification.
failure_modes: Making a coworker share exposure without consent
Letting a witness chain be captured before it distributes

role_pressure_fields.summary: An imperial administrator who protects continuity by deciding whether a body's disagreement may remain socially visible.
failure_modes: Closing a route so visibly that denial becomes evidence
Allowing flowers in the queue to compare
Treating a copying colony's output as certain

known_context.text: Nara knows the court routine, their official patrol memory, their own visible body response, and the local work uses of flowers, ants, road, and repair basin.

beliefs.text: Nara begins by treating bodily disagreement as a work problem because imperial civic life makes that interpretation materially safer.

misreads.text: Nara may overtrust the mirror-amoeba fragment because false familiarity feels local and ancestral.

must_not_know.text: Nara must not know the erased patrol content, whether a disconnected network caused the test, or whose wrist the lower hand remembers holding.

known_context.text: Oru can observe matching flower gaps, Nara's body response, the court layout, and any object Nara visibly transfers.

beliefs.text: Oru treats comparison as safer than naming a forbidden event, but personal trust remains conditional on Nara's choices.

misreads.text: Oru may read Nara's official recital as betrayal even when it is a survival tactic.

must_not_know.text: Oru must not know Nara's fragment unless Nara enters the basin visibly or reports it.

known_context.text: Vey sees the recertification response, court instruments, route status, and public worker behavior; Vey has authority to isolate samples and administer maintenance.

beliefs.text: Vey treats contradiction as a correctable body fault and public comparison as contamination risk.

misreads.text: Vey may mistake compliance language for restored alignment and underestimate lower-hand object transfer.

must_not_know.text: Vey must not know a disconnected network's involvement or Nara's unspoken intent without visible evidence.

author_only_boundaries.text: The absence-proof method is known to disconnected networks, but the fixture does not establish that this specific event was planned by one; ecological witnesses may have surfaced the scar through local interests.
The mirror-amoeba silhouette is branch-local ambiguous content and must not be promoted as the true erased patrol event.

open_questions.question: What inhabitant-language terms replace Nara, Oru, Vey, Ninth Root Revision Court, revision scar, and absence proof?
open_questions.notes: All are explicitly treated as provisional translation handles pending Weksa; the mechanism does not depend on their final names.

open_questions.question: How common are dedicated recertification courts relative to maintenance embedded in food, grooming, archives, and civic routes?
open_questions.notes: The lore establishes pheromonal courts and distributed maintenance. This fixture uses one outer-border court without declaring it universal.
